title.en: Open Columns settings on Cases page

description.en: Columns button opens the case list column dialog with hide/show and move controls.
description.uk: Columns button opens the case list column dialog with hide/show and move controls.

precondition.en: Signed in; project selected; Cases page open.
precondition.uk: Signed in; project selected; Cases page open.

action.en: Click the Columns|Стовпці button in the Cases toolbar.
action.uk: Click the Columns|Стовпці button in the Cases toolbar.

expected_result.en: Dialog cases.columnsSettings is visible with checkboxes and ←/→ move buttons.
expected_result.uk: Dialog cases.columnsSettings is visible with checkboxes and ←/→ move buttons.

title.en: Hide Priority column and keep Title visible
title.uk: Сховати Priority і залишити Title видимим

description.en: Optional columns can be hidden; Title checkbox stays disabled/checked.
description.uk: Optional columns can be hidden; Title checkbox stays disabled/checked.

action.en: Uncheck Priority in the Columns dialog; leave Title checked (disabled).
action.uk: Uncheck Priority in the Columns dialog; leave Title checked (disabled).

expected_result.en: Priority header disappears from [data-testid=case-list-head]; Title remains.
expected_result.uk: Priority header disappears from [data-testid=case-list-head]; Title remains.

title.en: Show Automated and Last run columns

description.en: Extra columns Automated (yes/no) and Last run status can be enabled.
description.uk: Extra columns Automated (yes/no) and Last run status can be enabled.

precondition.en: Cases page; at least one case with external_key and one with a result.
precondition.uk: Cases page; at least one case with external_key and one with a result.

action.en: In Columns dialog enable Automated and Last run; close dialog.
action.uk: In Columns dialog enable Automated and Last run; close dialog.

expected_result.en: Headers for Automated and Last run appear; cells show Yes/No and latest status or em dash.
expected_result.uk: Headers for Automated and Last run appear; cells show Yes/No and latest status or em dash.

title.en: Reorder columns with keyboard Move left/right

description.en: Column settings expose accessible Move left/right controls (in addition to header drag-and-drop).
description.uk: Column settings expose accessible Move left/right controls (in addition to header drag-and-drop).

precondition.en: Columns dialog open; Key and Title visible.
precondition.uk: Columns dialog open; Key and Title visible.

action.en: Activate Move right on the Key row (aria-label contains Move … right).
action.uk: Activate Move right on the Key row (aria-label contains Move … right).

expected_result.en: Key appears after Title (or next sibling) in the header order.
expected_result.uk: Key appears after Title (or next sibling) in the header order.

title.en: Server-side sort by Title across pages
title.uk: Серверне сортування за Title з пагінацією

description.en: Clicking a sortable header sends sort/order query params; works with Load more.
description.uk: Clicking a sortable header sends sort/order query params; works with Load more.

precondition.en: Project with enough cases to paginate (or any ≥2 cases).
precondition.uk: Project with enough cases to paginate (or any ≥2 cases).

action.en: Click the Title sort button in the case list header.
action.uk: Click the Title sort button in the case list header.

expected_result.en: URL/API request includes sort=title; rows reorder; Load more keeps the same sort.
expected_result.uk: URL/API request includes sort=title; rows reorder; Load more keeps the same sort.

description.en: Reset restores Key/Title/Priority/Status and clears extras.
description.uk: Reset restores Key/Title/Priority/Status and clears extras.

precondition.en: Columns customized (extra columns on, Priority hidden).
precondition.uk: Columns customized (extra columns on, Priority hidden).

action.en: Open Columns; click Reset to default|Скинути до типових.
action.uk: Open Columns; click Reset to default|Скинути до типових.

expected_result.en: Default four columns visible; Automated/Last run hidden again.
expected_result.uk: Default four columns visible; Automated/Last run hidden again.

title.en: Persist column prefs per project (API + localStorage)

description.en: PUT /preferences/case-list-columns when signed in; localStorage vulyk.caseList.columns.{projectId} as fallback.
description.uk: PUT /preferences/case-list-columns when signed in; localStorage vulyk.caseList.columns.{projectId} as fallback.

action.en: Customize columns on project A; reload; switch to project B then back to A.
action.uk: Customize columns on project A; reload; switch to project B then back to A.

expected_result.en: Project A layout restored from API (or localStorage); project B keeps its own defaults.
expected_result.uk: Project A layout restored from API (or localStorage); project B keeps its own defaults.

title.en: Custom field columns via registry extension

description.en: Project custom fields (boolean/select/multi_select/…) appear as cf:<uuid> columns when defined.
description.uk: Project custom fields (boolean/select/multi_select/…) appear as cf:<uuid> columns when defined.

precondition.en: Project has a custom field definition; cases have values.
precondition.uk: Project has a custom field definition; cases have values.

action.en: Enable the custom-field column in Columns; optionally sort by cf:<uuid>.
action.uk: Enable the custom-field column in Columns; optionally sort by cf:<uuid>.

expected_result.en: List rows include the field value; GET cases?cf_ids=…&sort=cf:<uuid> returns enriched items.
expected_result.uk: List rows include the field value; GET cases?cf_ids=…&sort=cf:<uuid> returns enriched items.
